title: The Wolf and the Lamb
old_p1: Heavenly Father showed Isaiah something brand new: new heavens and a new earth, so good that the old sorrows would not even come to mind.
There would be no more sound of weeping there, He said, and no more crying. Only gladness, and a people made of joy.
People would build houses and live in them, and plant vineyards and eat the fruit themselves. Nothing good would be carried away.
old_p2: The wolf and the lamb would eat side by side, and the lion would eat straw like a gentle ox. Nothing would hurt, and nothing would destroy, in all Heavenly Father's holy mountain.
Before you finish asking, He said, I will answer. Picture the lamb leaning warm against the wolf, both safe, both sleepy, just like you.
p1: Heavenly Father’s people were sad and far from home. So Heavenly Father showed Isaiah the happy ending that is coming one day: a new heaven and a new earth. That means Heavenly Father will make the whole world new and good, after Jesus comes again.
In that new world, Isaiah said, nobody will cry anymore. No more weeping. Only gladness and joy.
People will build houses and live in them. They will plant gardens and eat the fruit. Nobody will take their good things away.
p2: Even the animals will be friends. A wolf eats lambs, so a wolf and a lamb can never be together now. But in the new world, the wolf and the lamb will eat side by side. The lion will eat straw like a gentle cow. Nothing will hurt anyone on Heavenly Father’s holy mountain, which means the place where He lives with His people.
Heavenly Father said, “Before you even finish asking, I will answer.” Picture a lamb leaning warm against a wolf, both safe, both sleepy, just like you tonight.
